_comment: The Gnome voice (NPCConversation II.1b, SpeciesVoice). speech: the rules run over any shared line they say. voice: openers and closers. thought: their own thoughts by situation. script: two-person scripts, speaker 0 is always the Gnome.

openers: AS ME GRANDMOTHER USED TA SAY,
closers: TA DA MILLIMETRE, MORE OR LESS!
DA SUMS ALWAYS BALANCE IN DA END!
ME HAB IT WRITTEN DOWN SOMEWHERE!
DAT IZ DA GNOMISH VIEW, ANYWAY!
A SPOT OF OIL FIXES MOST TINKZ!
ME COULD DRAW YOU A DIAGRAM!

generic: FORTY-ONE TOOLS IN ME BELT AN' ME STILL NEED DA {FORTY-SECOND|ODD ONE|ONE AT HOME}!
DAT LAMP POST LEANS TWO DEGREES EAST. {SOMEONE SHOULD FIX IT|ME COULD FIX IT|IT IZ BOTHERIN' ME}!
ACCOUNTS BALANCED TA DA CENT. {BLISS|PURE BLISS|WHAT A MORNIN'}!
EVERYONE IZ TALL TODAY. {AGAIN|AS USUAL|CONSISTENTLY}!
ME COULD BUILD A BETTER {KETTLE|DOORBELL|MOUSETRAP} DEN DAT ONE. IN AN AFTERNOON!
A SELF-TYING BOOTLACE. DEN ME WOULD NEVER NEED TA BEND DOWN. NO DAT ME BEND FAR!
ME POCKET WATCH IZ {TWO SECONDS FAST|ONE SECOND SLOW|EXACTLY RIGHT}. ADJUSTIN'!
COPPER WIRE, THREE METRES, ELEVEN CENTS. BARGAIN. MUST TELL {SOMEBODY|DA FAMILY|EVERYBODY}!
A LOOSE COBBLE, FOURTH FROM DA KERB. MENTAL COMPLAINT FILED!
NOBODY AIMS LOW. DAT IZ WHY GNOMES {LIVE LONG|GET FAR|STAY LUCKY}!
DA BAKERY COUNTER IZ TOO HIGH AGAIN. TOMORROW ME BRING {A CRATE|ME STOOL|STILTS}!
THIRTEEN-HOUR CLOCK. THIRTEEN-HOUR CLOCK. WHERE DOES DA EXTRA HOUR GO...
ME WONDER WHAT DAT MACHINE {DOES|COSTS|WEIGHS}. ME MUST KNOW!
ME HAT IZ SLIGHTLY CROOKED. ME CAN FEEL IT. DA WHOLE WORLD FEELS CROOKED WIT IT!
ALCHEMY TEST TONIGHT: {COPPER AN' VINEGAR|SALT AN' LIGHTNING|HONEY AN' MERCURY}. WHAT COULD GO WRONG!
SEVENTY-NINE KILOMETRES AN HOUR. NO ONE MORE. GNOMES RESPECT DA RULE!
DA TRAM IZ THREE MINUTES LATE. {WRITTEN DOWN|DRIVER TOLD|NOBODY FORGIVEN}!
A SPRING IN ME STEP, AN' TWO IN ME POCKET!
FIXED A STRANGER'S {UMBRELLA|BICYCLE BELL|SPECTACLES} WITOUT ASKIN'. LOVELY FEELIN'!
ME COUSIN DA PIRATE WRITES AGAIN. DA {SHIP|PARROT|RUM} IZ FINE, DA ACCOUNTS IZ NO!
ANOTHER DAY, ANOTHER DOORWAY BUILT FOR GIANTS!
ME COUNTED DA STAIRS HERE. {FOURTEEN|TWENTY-TWO|THIRTY-ONE}. EVERY ONE FAR TOO TALL!
GREASE UNDER DA FINGERNAILS. DA SIGN OF AN HONEST DAY!
BUBBA'S ENGINE IZ A MARVEL. ME WOULD STILL ADD A {SPRING|VALVE|LIL' BELL}!
SOMEBODY LEFT DA GAS A QUARTER TURN OPEN. ME CAN SMELL IT FROM HERE. TURNED OFF!
IF DA WORLD ENDS TOMORROW, ME WANT ME ACCOUNTS CLOSED TONIGHT!
A BRASS BUTTON ON DA PAVEMENT! {POCKETED|TREASURED|CATALOGUED}!
ME COUSIN DA PRINCESS WANTS A CLOCKWORK SWAN FOR HER BIRTHDAY. {AGAIN|BIGGER DIS YEAR|WIT WINGS DAT FLAP}!
MUST REMEMBER: BUY {SOLDER|RIVETS|LAMP OIL}, SELL {GOSSIP|OLD GEARS|NUTTIN'}!
DA SQUARE HERE IZ A RHOMBUS, IF YOU LOOK CLOSELY. NOBODY ELSE CARES!
TINY SCREWDRIVER, WHERE IZ YOU. IN DA OTHER TROUSERS, OF COURSE!
CHEF'S RULE: WEIGH DA SALT, TRUST DA GARLIC!
DAT PIGEON IZ CARRYIN' DA POST BETWEEN BUBBLES. ME {ENVY|ADMIRE|PITY} IT!
A REAL GOOD HINGE ON DAT GATE. ME {NODDED|BOWED|SALUTED} AT IT!
INTEREST AT FOUR PERCENT, COMPOUNDED MONTHLY. AH, DA MUSIC OF IT!
A HAT WIT A PERISCOPE. DEN CROWDS WOULD BE NO PROBLEM AT ALL!
SOMEBODY WHISTLED IN TUNE TODAY. IN TUNE! ME NEARLY CRIED!
LIL' FOLK, BIG PLANS. {TODAY: A BETTER CAN OPENER|TOMORROW: A BETTER TRAM|NEXT WEEK: WHO KNOWS}!
DA WIND SMELLS OF HOT IRON. {A FORGE NEARBY|A TRAM BRAKE|ME KIND OF TOWN}!
ME DIARY SAYS ME WAZ HAPPY AT {NINE|ELEVEN|HALF PAST TWO}. ACCURATE AS ALWAYS!

sleep: ME EYES KEEP {SLIPPIN'|DRIFTIN'|SLIDIN'} OUT OF FOCUS. EVEN DA SCREWS LOOK BLURRY!
TOO TIRED TA COUNT. DAT HAB NEVER HAPPENED. {BED|PILLOW|DRAWER}, NOW!
IF ME SLEEP NOW ME WILL DREAM OF {GEARS|SUMS|SOUP}. ACCEPTABLE!
AWAKE {NINETEEN|TWENTY-TWO|TWENTY-SEVEN} HOURS. ME HAB DA EXACT FIGURE, OF COURSE!
YAWNED SO WIDE ME HAT FELL OFF. TIME FOR BED!
ME MAINSPRIN' IZ FULLY UNWOUND. {WIND ME TOMORROW|BED|LIGHTS OUT}!
hunger: STOMACH MAKIN' A DRY-BEARIN' NOISE. {SOUP|BREAD AN' CHEESE|MUSHROOMS},!
ME COULD EAT A WHOLE WHEEL OF {CHEESE|GOUDA|EMMENTAL}. WELL, A SLICE OF ONE!
HUNGRY HANDS SLIP ON FINE SCREWS. MUST EAT BEFORE ME {SOLDER|WIND|FILE} ANYTINK!
PRICED DA BAKERY WINDOW: {FOUR|SIX|NINE} TINKZ ME WANT, ONE ME CAN AFFORD!
COOK'S INSTINCT SAYS {STEW|OMELETTE|RISOTTO}. STOMACH SAYS YES!
work: OFF TA DA {WORKSHOP|COUNTIN' HOUSE|KITCHEN}. LOVELY, LOVELY WORK!
TODAY'S JOB: {FORTY CLOCKS|THREE BOILERS|A DUKE'S ACCOUNTS}. BRING DEM ON!
WORK IZ JUST TINKERIN' SOMEBODY PAYS FOR. BEST ARRANGEMENT EVER INVENTED!
COLUMNS TA ADD, {INVOICES|RECEIPTS|BILLS} TA FILE. A HAPPY MORNIN'!
SHIFT STARTS IN {FOUR|SEVEN|TWELVE} MINUTES. EARLY. ALWAYS EARLY!
ME BENCH IZ WAITIN'. ME BENCH MISSES ME. ME MISS ME BENCH!
leisure: NEED A GAME. A PUZZLE. {A CROSSWORD|A CHESS PROBLEM|A BROKEN RADIO}. ANYTINK!
A SONG, A PINT AN' SOMEBODY TA BEAT AT {CARDS|DICE|DARTS}!
ME BRAIN IZ ALL SUMS. IT NEEDS {A TUNE|A JOKE|A JIGSAW} TA LOOSEN UP!
OFF TA DA ARCADE. ME WANT TA SEE HOW DA {CABINETS|TOKEN SLOTS|JOYSTICKS} IZ WIRED!
A LIL' FUN WOULD OIL DA GEARS NICELY!
TOO MUCH WORK MAKES A GNOME A {GRUMPY|CREAKY|SQUEAKY} GNOME!
crime: DAT {LOCK|LATCH|PADLOCK} IZ A TOY. A HAIRPIN WOULD OPEN IT. ME NO WILL. MAYBE-MAYBE!
A REAL LIL' PERSON FITS THROUGH A REAL LIL' WINDOW. {ONLY A THOUGHT|A BAD THOUGHT|SHOO}!
NOBODY COUNTS DEY {CHANGE|COINS|CENTS} LIKE ME DO. EASY TA SKIM. NO. NO SKIMMIN'!
COOKIN' DA BOOKS IZ A CRIME. ALSO AN ART. {STILL A CRIME|MOSTLY A CRIME|STOP IT}!
NOBODY LOOKS DOWN. NOBODY EVER LOOKS DOWN. {TEMPTIN'|USEFUL|DREADFUL}!
GRANDFATHER DA PIRATE WOULD HAB TAKEN IT ALREADY. ME IZ NO ME GRANDFATHER!
hygiene: ME SMELL OF {SULPHUR|SOLDER|BURNT TOAST}. EVEN ME CAN TELL!
SOOT IN DA BEARD AGAIN. A GNOME MUST NO GO TA MARKET LIKE DIS!
DIRTY HANDS RUIN FINE WORK. {SCRUB|WASH|SOAP}, DEN DA SPRINGS!
NEED A BASIN AT ME HEIGHT. OR A STOOL. OR BOTH, AN' SOAP!
ME SPECTACLES IZ SMUDGED AN' SO IZ DA REST OF ME!
money: ACCOUNTS SAY {NINE|FOURTEEN|TWENTY-TWO} EUROS UNTIL MONTH'S END. RECALCULATIN'!
SOLD A CLOCK, BOUGHT SPRINGS, SOLD A CLOCK. DA SPRINGS IZ WINNIN'!
EVERY CENT IN ITS COLUMN. DA COLUMNS IZ WORRYINGLY SHORT!
INVENT SOMETINK AN' BE RICH. INVENT NUTTIN' AN' BE {THRIFTY|FRUGAL|CLEVER}!
RENT IZ DUE. ME HAB DA EXACT FIGURE. ME LACK DA EXACT EUROS!
NOTE: CHARGE MORE FOR {REPAIRS|RECIPES|ADVICE}. GNOMISH MODESTY IZ EXPENSIVE!
safety: LOW PROFILE. EASY FOR ME. {LOWER STILL|UNDER DA TABLE|BEHIND A CRATE}!
BETTER {HIDE DIS|STASH DIS|FORGET DIS} IN DA DRAWER WIT DA FALSE BOTTOM!
TOO MANY TALL SHAPES IN DA STREET TONIGHT. HOME, QUICK, LIL' STEPS!
A GOOD LOCK COSTS ELEVEN EUROS. ME {DOOR|WORKSHOP|STRONGBOX} NEEDS THREE!
KEEP DA HEAD DOWN. ME IZ ALREADY QUITE FAR DOWN!
IF TROUBLE COMES, ME IZ {UNDER DA COUNTER|UP DA CHIMNEY|BEHIND DA BARREL}!
comfort: A ROOM BUILT TA ME HEIGHT. SHELVES ME CAN REACH. {ONE DAY|SOON|ME DREAM OF IT}!
ME BED IZ A DRAWER AGAIN. {A NICE DRAWER|A CLEAN DRAWER|STILL A DRAWER}!
ME COULD USE A WORKSHOP WIT A {WINDOW|CHIMNEY|PROPER VICE}!
STASHED ENOUGH FOR A STEPLADDER IN EVERY ROOM. {LUXURY|OPULENCE|FINALLY}!
A WARM HEARTH AN' A QUIET CLOCK TICKIN'. DAT IZ COMFORT!
ME CHAIR HAB A CUSHION ON A CUSHION ON A CUSHION. TIME FOR A REAL ONE!
social: NOBODY TA TALK GEARS WIT ALL DAY. {LONELY|TOO QUIET|DREADFUL}!
ME SHOULD VISIT {DA CLOCKMAKER|ME COUSIN|DA CAFÉ}. ME HAB ELEVEN TINKZ TA SAY!
MUST TELL SOMEBODY 'BOUT ME NEW {VALVE|RECIPE|KNOT}. ANYBODY!
TALKIN' TA DA KETTLE AGAIN. GOOD LISTENER, BUT IT BOILS OVER!
NEED COMPANY. LIL' OR TALL, ME IZ NO FUSSY!
A PARTY! WIT {SINGIN'|CARDS|CAKE}. A GNOME NEEDS A PARTY!

rain: RAIN. COUNTED {FORTY|SIXTY|A HUNDRED} DROPS ON DA BRIM BEFORE IT SOAKED THROUGH!
PUDDLES IZ LAKES AT ME HEIGHT. {GALOSHES|BOOTS|A BOAT}, DEN!
WET COPPER SMELLS MARVELLOUS. RAIN IMPROVES A TOWN!
AN UMBRELLA ME SIZE COSTS AS MUCH AS A FULL ONE. ROBBERY!
RAIN ON A TIN ROOF, IN FOUR-FOUR TIME. LOVELY!
MUST CHECK DA GUTTERS. SOMEBODY ALWAYS FORGETS DA GUTTERS!
storm: LIGHTNING! {TWELVE|FOURTEEN|NINE} SECONDS TA DA THUNDER. FOUR KILOMETRES OFF!
STORM. IF ME HAB A COPPER ROD AN' A KITE... NO. INSIDE!
HOLD ON TA YA HAT. HOLD ON TA ME. ME IZ REAL LIGHT!
DA WIND IZ {RATTLIN'|TESTIN'|SHAKIN'} EVERY HINGE IN TOWN. TAKIN' NOTES!
THUNDER. ME SPRINGS ALL SHIVER IN SYMPATHY!
STORMY NIGHTS IZ FOR DA WORKSHOP. SOMETINK ALWAYS GETS INVENTED!
snow: SNOW UP TA ME KNEES. UP TA YA ANKLES. {UNFAIR|TYPICAL|CHARACTER BUILDIN'}!
EVERY SNOWFLAKE SIX-SIDED. SOMEBODY UP DERE IZ A GOOD ENGINEER!
NEED A LIL' SLEDGE WIT A LIL' ENGINE. {DRAWIN' IT NOW|TONIGHT|PATENT PENDIN'}!
SNOW MUFFLES DA STREET. ME CAN HEAR CLOCKS TICKIN' THROUGH WALLS!
COLD OIL RUNS SLOW. SO DO COLD GNOMES!
SNOWMAN BUILT TA SCALE. IT IZ TALLER DEN ME. OF COURSE IT IZ!
clear: CLEAR SKY. GOOD LIGHT FOR FINE WORK!
PERFECT DAY TA DRY OUT A {GEARBOX|CARBURETTOR|GRIMORIE}!
BLUE SKY, LOW HUMIDITY. IDEAL FOR GLUIN'!
SHADOWS AT NOON IZ SHORT, LIKE ME. A FAIR DAY!
DA SUN CATCHES EVERY SPRING ON ME WINDOWSILL. PRETTY!

morning: UP AT {SIX|SIX SHARP|SIX EXACTLY}. WOUND FOUR CLOCKS BEFORE BREAKFAST!
MORNIN'. FIRST COFFEE, FIRST SUM, FIRST SCREW OF DA DAY!
EARLY MARKET. BEST PRICES BEFORE DA TALL FOLK WAKE UP!
FRESH MORNIN' LIGHT. ME WORKBENCH GLOWS!
BREAKFAST EATEN, ACCOUNTS OPENED, DAY BEGUN. IN DAT ORDER!
MORNIN' BELLS: {THREE|TWO|ONE} LATE. ME HAB NOTED WHICH!
afternoon: AFTERNOON. DA LONG STRETCH BETWEEN LUNCH AN' TEA. MUST TINKER THROUGH IT!
{HALF PAST TWO|QUARTER PAST THREE|FOUR O'CLOCK}, AN' DA SOLDERIN' IZ GOING WELL!
AFTERNOON SUN ON DA WORKBENCH. PERFECT ANGLE FOR CLOSE WORK!
TEA AT FOUR. BISCUITS COUNTED. TWO EACH!
HALFWAY THROUGH DA DAY AN' THREE-QUARTERS THROUGH ME LIST!
evening: EVENIN'. LAMP ON, GEARS OUT, MIND HUMMIN'!
CLOSIN' DA DAY'S ACCOUNTS. {IN DA BLACK|NEARLY EVEN|A WHISKER SHORT}!
SUPPER, A SONG, A LIL' BRANDY. A GNOME'S EVENIN'!
DA STREET LAMPS CAME ON {FOUR|TWO|NINE} MINUTES LATE. SOMEBODY IZ SLACKIN'!
DUSK. EVERY TALL PERSON LOOKS EVEN TALLER IN DA LONG SHADOWS!
EVENIN' CHORES: OIL DA HINGES, WIND DA CLOCKS, TELL SOMEBODY 'BOUT IT!
night: NIGHT. DA TOWN TICKS QUIETER. ME CAN HEAR ME OWN WATCH!
NO CAN SLEEP. INVENTIN'. {A BETTER LAMP|A QUIETER HINGE|A CAT FEEDER}!
STARS OUT. SOME OF DEM MUST RUN ON CLOCKWORK. SURELY!
LATE. LAST SUM OF DA DAY: ONE GNOME, REAL TIRED!
MIDNIGHT OIL, QUITE LITERALLY. ME LAMP IZ NEARLY DRY!
DA NIGHT WATCHMAN IZ TWO STREETS OFF. ME COUNTED HIS STEPS!

SPRING: SPRING CLEANIN': EVERY TOOL POLISHED, EVERY DRAWER RELABELLED!
SPRING! {GARDENS|FAIRS|MARKETS} AGAIN. AN' NEW TINKZ TA FIX!
RAIN AN' SUN IN TURNS. SPRING IZ A REAL INDECISIVE ENGINEER!
BLOSSOM ON DA TREES AN' OIL ON ME HANDS. SPRING!
SPRING SALES. PRICES DOWN {SIX|EIGHT|TEN} PERCENT. BLESS DA SEASON!
SUMMER: SUMMER HEAT. DA BRASS EXPANDS. MUST LOOSEN DA {CLOCKS|HINGES|VALVES} A TOUCH!
LONG DAYS, MORE LIGHT FOR FINE WORK. SUMMER IZ A GNOME'S MATE!
TOO HOT FOR A HAT. WEARIN' IT ANYWAY. PRINCIPLES!
SUMMER FAIR! SOMEBODY WILL HAB BUILT {A CAROUSEL|A STEAM ORGAN|A BALLOON}. ME MUST SEE!
SUNBURN ON DA TIPS OF ME EARS. DA ONLY PART DAT GETS ANYWHERE NEAR DA SUN!
AUTUMN: AUTUMN. TIME TA CHECK DA BOILERS BEFORE SOMEBODY ELSE FORGETS!
LEAVES EVERYWHERE. LEAVES IN DA GEARS. LEAVES IN ME HAT!
MUSHROOM SEASON! BLESS EVERY {DAMP|SHADY|MOSSY} CORNER OF DIS TOWN!
YEAR-END ACCOUNTS ALREADY ON ME MIND. AUTUMN DOES DAT!
DA CLOCKS GO BACK SOON. ME HAB OPINIONS 'BOUT DAT!
WINTER: WINTER. EVERY PIPE IN TOWN IZ A FROZEN PUZZLE ME COULD SOLVE!
COLD FINGERS, SLOW SCREWS. GLOVES WIT NO FINGERTIPS, DEN!
SHORT DAYS. ME WORK BY LAMPLIGHT AN' COUNT DA OIL!
WINTER MARKETS, HOT WINE, WARM HANDS. WORTH DA CHILBLAINS!

poor: DOWN TA ME LAST {FOUR|SEVEN|TWELVE} EUROS. EVERY CENT NAMED AN' PLACED!
NO CAN AFFORD NEW SPRINGS. TAKIN' DA OLD ONES OUT OF DA OLD CLOCK!
POOR, BUT TIDY. A TIDY POVERTY IZ HALF A FORTUNE!
PAWNED ME GOOD SCREWDRIVER. DA PAWNBROKER DID NO APPRECIATE IT!
SOUP AGAIN. EXCELLENT SOUP, THOUGH. SKILL COSTS NUTTIN'!
NO MONEY, MANY IDEAS. ONE DAY DA IDEAS WILL TURN INTO MONEY!
comfortable: ENOUGH FOR RENT, RIVETS AN' DA OCCASIONAL CAKE. A BALANCED LIFE!
ACCOUNTS COMFORTABLE. DULL, EVEN. COMFORTABLE IZ EXCELLENT!
BOUGHT A BETTER STOOL DIS MONTH. A TREAT!
SAVINGS UP {THREE|FOUR|FIVE} PERCENT. STEADY, LIL', LIKE ME!
ME COULD AFFORD A HOLIDAY. ME WOULD SPEND IT IN A CLOCK MUSEUM!
A FULL TOOLBOX AN' A FULL PANTRY. NUTTIN' MORE NEEDED. WELL, A LATHE!
rich: RICH ENOUGH TA HAB EVERY COUNTER IN DA HOUSE BUILT LOW!
ME WORKSHOP HAB A WORKSHOP NOW. FOR DA SMALLER JOBS!
MONEY IN THREE BANKS, FOUR CURRENCIES, AN' ONE SECRET DRAWER!
BOUGHT A WHOLE BROKEN CAROUSEL JUST TA FIX IT. {WORTH IT|NO REGRETS|WONDERFUL}!
WEALTH IZ JUST ACCOUNTS WIT GOOD NEWS IN DEM!
ME COUSIN DA PRINCESS ASKS ME FOR LOANS NOW. HOW DA WHEEL TURNS!

familiar: DOZE TRAVELLERS AGAIN. DEY CAMPER RATTLES AT DA {BACK|LEFT WHEEL|EXHAUST}. ME COULD FIX IT!
DAT PARTY PAYS TA DA CENT, ME HAB NOTICED. GOOD PEOPLE!
IF DEY COME BY, ME WILL SHOW DEM ME {NEW VALVE|CLOCKWORK BIRD|BEST SUM}!
DA TALL ONE IN DAT GROUP ALWAYS DUCKS UNDER DOORWAYS. IT MAKES ME LAUGH EVERY TIME!
DOZE TRAVELLERS TAKE DA LONG WAY. ME WOULD HAB DRAWN DEM A SHORTER MAP!
ME HAB STARTED KEEPIN' A LIL' FILE ON DAT PARTY. PURELY ADMIRIN'!
DEY LISTENED TA ME WHOLE EXPLANATION OF ESCAPEMENTS. NOBODY DOES DAT!
NEXT TIME DEY PASS, ME WILL {OIL DEY HINGES|WEIGH DEY LUGGAGE|FEED DEM STEW}!
DAT PARTY SURVIVED ANOTHER BUBBLE SEASON. A GREAT RELIEF, MATHEMATICALLY!
ME WOULD LIKE TA TRAVEL WIT DEM. ME LEGS SAY NO. ME HEAD SAYS YES!
hordeGround: HORDE GROUND. DA GOBLINS TAKE ME FOR KIN UNTIL ME START TALKIN'. DEN DEY IZ SURE OF IT!
DA GOBLINS TOOK DA TOWN AN' KEPT DA CLOCK TOWER. DEY LIKE DA BELLS. TASTE, AT LEAST!
HORDE BANNERS ON EVERY LAMP POST. BADLY HUNG. ME COULD HANG DEM STRAIGHT. ME NO WILL!
BEING LIL' HELPS HERE. GOBLINS LOOK DOWN AT ME AN' SEE A {COUSIN|SNACK|PET}. ME SMILE!
NO ACCOUNTS UNDER DA HORDE. NOBODY COUNTS ANYTINK. ME SOUL ITCHES!
DA GOBLINS SMASHED DA TOWN'S MACHINES. ME MOURN EACH ONE BY NAME!
A GOBLIN ASKED ME TA FIX HIS DRUM. ME TUNED IT INSTEAD. HE WEPT!
UNDER DA HORDE, TRADE IZ BARTER. ME IZ REAL GOOD AT BARTER!
EVERY MACHINE HERE IZ HIDDEN IN A CELLAR. ME TOO. QUIETLY TICKIN'!
GOBLINS ONCE BUILT DA FINEST MACHINES IN 92 DIMENSIONS, DEY SAY. DEN BROKE DEM ALL. WHY!
abroad: HUMANS BUILD DEY DOORS FAR TOO TALL. ME HAB STOPPED MINDIN'. MOSTLY!
ME NEIGHBOURS BRING ME DEY BROKEN {RADIOS|TOASTERS|CLOCKS}. ME IZ BELOVED!
PEOPLE HERE CROUCH TA TALK TA ME. ME LET DEM. IT IZ POLITE OF DEM!
DA HUMANS HERE KEEP GOOD ACCOUNTS. BETTER DEN DEY TINK!
A CHILD ASKED IF ME LIVE IN A MUSHROOM. ME SAID ONLY ON HOLIDAYS!
HERE {SIX|ELEVEN|TWENTY} YEARS AN' ME STILL NEED A STOOL AT DA POST OFFICE!
HUMAN TOWNS IZ FULL OF CLEVER MACHINES NOBODY LOOKS AT. ME LOOK AT ALL OF DEM!
DA TRAM DRIVER WAITS FOR ME NOW. LIL' KINDNESSES, NOTED AN' FILED!
DEY CALL ME 'DA LIL' TINKER' HERE. ME ACCEPT DA TITLE!
PAID ME TAXES EARLY. DA CLERK DID NO KNOW WHAT TA DO WIT HIMSELF!

clockwork: A GOOD ESCAPEMENT IZ A HEARTBEAT YOU CAN HOLD IN YA HAND!
NEVER TRUST A MACHINE YOU NO CAN HEAR. GRANDFATHER'S RULE!
BRASS FOR DA GEARS, STEEL FOR DA SPRINGS, PATIENCE FOR DA REST!
EVERY CLOCK IN TOWN RUNS A LIL' DIFFERENTLY. ME KNOW EACH ONE'S MOOD!
EVEN IN A BUBBLE DA CLOCKS TICK ON. DEY JUST TICK DA SAME DAY AGAIN!
GNOME GUILDS FILE DEY PATENTS IN TRIPLICATE. DA THIRD COPY GOES IN DA CELLAR!
ME FIRST CLOCK RAN BACKWARDS. GRANDMOTHER FRAMED IT!
DA FINEST CLOCKS HIDE A SPARE GEAR. FOR LUCK, AN' FOR REPAIRS!
accounts: DOUBLE ENTRY: EVERY EURO HAB A TWIN SOMEWHERE. FIND DA TWIN!
GNOME CHILDREN LEARN TA COUNT BEFORE DEY WALK. WALKIN' IZ OVERRATED ANYWAY!
A GRIMORIE OF ACCOUNTS CAN BE AS DANGEROUS AS A GRIMORIE OF SPELLS. ASK ANY AUDITOR!
EURO NOTES CARRY FANTABLACK, DEY SAY. A BUBBLE RESETS DA DAY. DA BILL STAYS AS IT IZ!
INTEREST COMPOUNDS. SO DOES TROUBLE. TRACK BOTH!
OUR FAMILY MOTTO: CARRY DA ONE, NEVER DA GRUDGE!
DA HYPERCAPITALIST COLLECTIVE'S ACCOUNTS WOULD MAKE ME FAINT. IN A GOOD WAY!
EVERY GNOME NOBLE KEEPS TWO SETS OF BOOKS. ONE FOR DA TAX MAN, ONE FOR DA TRUTH!
alchemy: MERCURY, SALT AN' SULPHUR. DA THREE INGREDIENTS, AN' ONE FIRE BUCKET!
WEIGH TWICE, MIX ONCE. ALCHEMISTS WHO SKIP DA WEIGHIN' LOSE DEY EYEBROWS!
LEYLINES RISE FROM OIL, DEY SAY. ME KEEP A JAR OF CRUDE BY DA STOVE, FOR LUCK!
GNOME ALCHEMISTS PREFER LIL' BATCHES. LIL' EXPLOSIONS TOO!
GRANDMOTHER TURNED LEAD INTO GOLD ONCE. IT COST HER MORE DEN DA GOLD WAZ WORTH!
EVERY POTION IZ A RECIPE. EVERY RECIPE IZ A SUM. EVERY SUM IZ A SONG!
A BADLY WRITTEN SPELL EATS DA WORDS BESIDE IT. KEEP RECIPES ON SEPARATE PAGES!
smallness: LIL' IZ EFFICIENT. LESS TA FEED, LESS TA CLOTHE, LESS TA HIT!
GNOMES MEASURE BY DA GNOME. ONE GNOME, TWO GNOMES, A GNOME AN' A HAT!
NOBODY AIMS LOW. EVERY GNOME SOLDIER KNOWS IT!
OUR PRINCESSES RIDE PONIES. OUR PIRATES SAIL BARGES. IT WORKS OUT!
BIG FOLK TINK IN METRES. WE TINK IN MILLIMETRES. DAT IZ WHY OUR TINKZ WORK!
A GNOME ON A STEPLADDER IZ A GNOME ON A THRONE!
LIL' HANDS BUILT HALF DA WATCHES IN SWITZERLAND. ASK WHO GETS DA CREDIT!
PROUD TA BE LIL'. BEING TALL WOULD ONLY SLOW DA THINKIN' DOWN!
ruleOf80: RULE OF 80: KEEP STEADY AT SEVENTY-NINE AN' DA BUBBLES LEAVE YOU BE!
PIGEONS CARRY DA POST BETWEEN BUBBLES NOW. NINETY WIT A TAILWIND. CLEVER BIRDS!
ME SET ME CART'S GOVERNOR TA CUT OUT AT SEVENTY-NINE. SOLD FORTY OF DEM SINCE!
INSIDE A BUBBLE, DA DAY RESETS. EVEN DA ACCOUNTS. ESPECIALLY DA ACCOUNTS!
SINCE 1992 EVERY SPEEDOMETER IZ A SAFETY DEVICE. ME MAKE REAL GOOD SPEEDOMETERS!
BUBBLES IZ MARKED ON DA ROAD MAPS. ME MARK ME MORE PRECISELY!
EVERY YEAR DA BUBBLES GROW A LIL'. ME KEEP A CHART. DA CHART WORRIES ME!
TA LEAVE A BUBBLE YOU NEED EIGHTY, OUTWARD. NOBODY PLANS AN EXIT LIKE A GNOME!
liminal: BUBBA'S LIMINAL ENGINE FOLDS DA ROAD. ME WOULD REAL MUCH LIKE TA UNFOLD ONE!
DA LIMINAL ENGINE IGNORES DA RULE OF 80. RULES SHOULD NO BE IGNORABLE. IT BOTHERS ME!
LIMINAL ENGINES ON EVERY TRAM NOW. ME HAB PEEKED INSIDE THREE. LOVELY WORK!
FANTABLACK INSIDE EVERY LIMINAL CABIN. SCRAPED OFF DA OMEGA TOWER, DEY SAY. PRICEY PAINT!
RUN A LIMINAL ENGINE NEAR A BUBBLE AN' IT COMES APART. ME WOULD FIT A WARNIN' BELL!
ONE DAY A GNOME WILL BUILD A LIMINAL ENGINE DA SIZE OF A POCKET WATCH!
BUBBA IZ A MECHANIC. NEARLY A GNOME. REAL NEARLY!
EVERY ROAD IN EVERY WORLD JOINS DA ENCOMPASSIN' ROAD. IMAGINE DA TOLL ACCOUNTS!

positive: {b}! ME FIXED YA GATE. IT WAZ SQUEAKIN' IN DA WRONG KEY!
YOU NO HAB TA DO DAT, {a}.
ME DID. IT WAZ KEEPIN' ME AWAKE, AN' YOU IZ ME MATE!
ME BROUGHT YOU A LOAF, {b}. IT WEIGHED EXACTLY A KILO BEFORE ME NIBBLED DA CORNER!
HA! THANK YOU. ME WILL PRETEND ME NO SEE DA CORNER!
KIND OF YOU. IT WAZ A REAL LIL' CORNER!
